summary: Full backend + frontend testing of OurSpace (Postgres/Supabase, superadmin + multi-space model). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed including auth, change-password flag, space CRUD, member/nickname endpoints, media isolation, chat scoping, role-based 403s, and AI generate (Gemini nano-banana returned 200). Frontend: admin login → change-pw (already-changed path) → spaces dashboard → create space via FAB (credentials modal displays generated slug usernames + welcome123) → delete space → logout all working. Member login (pine-26/welcome123) → forced change-password → gallery shows space name at top + 'Add Photos / Videos' button → chat send/echo works → profile shows other members with nickname inputs, saving nickname persists. All critical flows functional. NOTE: admin password was rotated by pytest to 'admin1234' (test asserts backend flip). NOTE: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is stale (documents old duovault Mongo user1/user2 seed – no longer applicable to Postgres multi-space model).

minor.issue: list_spaces builds member_count then re-queries all users via a second select and uses len(members); the initial member_count scalar query is unused – minor inefficiency, no functional impact.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete space (trash icon) has no confirmation dialog – accidental taps immediately cascade-delete space + members + media + chat.

issues: Nicknames section only renders after api.spaceMembers() finishes; a brief blank flash occurs on first mount (no skeleton/loader for that section).
Hint text still says 'Admin default: admin / admin123' but per problem spec admin must change password on first login – hint is fine for fresh installs but becomes misleading after rotation.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on multiple screens. Likely from a third-party RN component; not blocking but should be triaged. Reference: seen in browser console during login/change-password/profile screens.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md – it still references the old MongoDB duovault user1/user2 seed and is misleading. Replace with the new OurSpace flow: admin/admin123 (first login forces change), member accounts are created dynamically via admin.
Add a confirm dialog before space delete in app/(admin)/spaces.tsx (destructive, cascades to media/chat/members).
Optional: add a loading indicator / skeleton for the 'Nicknames for Others' section in profile.tsx while members are being fetched to avoid the momentary empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_spaces (line 237) computes an unused scalar member_count, then re-queries members and uses len() – dead code, remove the first select.
frontend/app/(admin)/spaces.tsx: destructive delete has no confirmation.
Nickname endpoint accepts empty string to clear – confirmed working, but there is no explicit DELETE route; empty string is used as sentinel. Fine but worth documenting.
server.py hardcodes admin default password in seed; must_change_password flag correctly forces rotation, good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (admin CRUD, member login, change-pw, gallery, chat, profile, nicknames)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates TEST_SpaceA/TEST_SpaceB and deletes them at end. UI tests created UIMember_Space with pine-26/cove-31 and cleaned up via API at end of run. Admin password is now 'admin1234' (rotated by change-password test; must_change_password=false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin credentials are now admin/admin1234 (must_change_password=false). No spaces currently exist. Use POST /api/spaces via admin token to create fresh members. Frontend EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL points to preview URL. pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_ourspace_api.py – it is idempotent and self-cleaning. Gemini AI generate endpoint returned 200 on the test run (quota available at test time).
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Only minor UX/consistency items (confirm dialog on delete, stale memory doc, cosmetic pointerEvents warning).
